description: This Java source file defines a class 'CreateThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl' which is a builder for creating responses and events related to a 'CreateThingLiveCommand' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to generate success responses and events like 'ThingCreated' and error responses such as 'ThingConflict'.

classes.name: CreateThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: A concrete implementation of a builder for creating responses and events for a 'CreateThingLiveCommand'. It provides factory methods for success and error responses, and event creation.

classes.name: ResponseFactoryImpl
classes.description: Inner class implementing 'ResponseFactory' to generate success ('created') response and conflict error response.

classes.name: EventFactoryImpl
classes.description: Inner class implementing 'EventFactory' to generate a 'ThingCreated' event.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the builder with the given 'CreateThingLiveCommand'.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Uses the provided function to create a `CommandResponse` object based on the response factory.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Uses the provided function to create an event based on the event factory.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Within ResponseFactoryImpl, generates a 'CreateThingResponse' indicating successful creation.

methods.name: thingConflictError
methods.description: Within ResponseFactoryImpl, generates a 'ThingErrorResponse' representing a conflict error.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Within EventFactoryImpl, creates a 'ThingCreated' event with current timestamp.
